correctness.rationale: Exact clock coupling and run-avoiding cyclic transfer establish the finite-n CDF; the Perron root identity gives \(\log\Lambda=-q^\ell+q^{\ell+1}+O(q^{2\ell})\), while all other eigenvalues are \(O(q)\). Substitution at \(q=n^{-1/\ell}\exp(-x/\ell)\) yields the stated compact-uniform first correction. The checker passes 136 assertions from exact rational enumeration, high-precision asymptotics, and independent physical-process simulations. No finite enumeration is used to prove the infinite asymptotic.

value.rationale: The nontrivial \(n^{-1/\ell}\) completion-time bias is a natural finite-substrate kinetic measure in an irreversible deposition model. It exhibits the quantitatively sharp effect of correlated surviving vacancies, beyond the known Gumbel weak law, for every fixed segment length ell >=2. It is not an arbitrary finite parameter or unsupported application, and no general theorem from these source comparisons already fixes the coefficient.
